# Project RPM — Audience-Fit Validator

**Find Your Product-Market Fit by AI Persona.** Give it a URL, get back a 0-100 audience-fit score, AARRR funnel diagnostic, and friction clusters — generated by 112 simulated personas across 8 demographic cohorts reacting to a single screenshot. Phase 5+ adds real human respondents who feed the same scoring pipeline for direct AI-vs-Human comparison reports.

![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-5.7-3178C6?logo=typescript&logoColor=white)

![Anthropic](https://img.shields.io/badge/Anthropic-Claude_Sonnet_+_Haiku-D97757)

> **Live**: [app.project-rpm.xyz](https://app.project-rpm.xyz) (web) · [api.project-rpm.xyz](https://api.project-rpm.xyz) (api)
>
> **Status**: post-pivot (2026-05-04), post-Sui-migration (2026-06). The earlier autotest marketplace (Stagehand-driven autonomous testing, x402 micropayments, SAS attestation, 41R Token-2022 with transfer fee) was removed in the pivot, and the chain layer migrated Solana → **Sui** (the `@solana/*` deps, `packages/solana-utils`, sponsored-tx / fee-payer code, and the `/api/scan/:id/payment-tx` + `/payment-confirm` routes were all deleted). The pivot rationale is in [`docs/pivot-strategy.md`](docs/pivot-strategy.md); the current system is walked through in [`docs/HOW-IT-WORKS.md`](docs/HOW-IT-WORKS.md).
>

## What it does

```
POST /api/scan  { target_url }
   ↓
Playwright captures one screenshot
   ↓
Claude Haiku 4.5 classifies the site (category + value-prop) +
   generates 3-5 site-specific human-survey questions
   ↓
8 demographic cohorts × 14 personas = 112 simulated visitors
   each persona has a vector (demographics, expertise, voice sample)
   ↓
Claude Sonnet 4.6 vision-scores each persona's reaction to the
   screenshot across 5 dimensions (engagement, task_success, happiness,
   adoption, retention_d7) + a free-text "biggest friction" quote
   ↓
Aggregation:
   - Per-cohort fit score (DIMENSION_WEIGHTS_V1, bootstrap CI)
   - Headline audience-fit score (Option A: 0.4·best + 0.3·median + ...)
   - Friction clustering (Claude Haiku groups voice quotes into 3-5 themes)
   - AARRR funnel (cumulative: acquisition → activation → ... → revenue)
   ↓
Report at /validator/report/<scanId>
   ↓
[ Phase 5 — async ]
Real humans take the SAME survey at /validator/survey/<scanId> (Privy auth)
   ↓
Operator clicks "Compare with humans (n=X)" on the report
   ↓
Human responses pipe through the IDENTICAL aggregation pipeline,
   producing an AI-shape human report + AI-vs-Human diff at
   /validator/compare/<scanId>
```

**Two modes:**

- **Mode A — Discovery**: all 8 cohorts × 14 = 112 personas. Headline `audience_fit_score` is a 4-component composite.
- **Mode B — Verification**: a single audience parsed from natural language (`"30s DeFi expert mobile-first"`). One bucket of ≤50 matching personas. Verdict: ≥60 pass / 40-60 conditional / <40 fail.

### Core math invariants (locked by tests)

1. `audience_fit_score = 0.4·best + 0.3·median + 0.2·task_global + 0.1·sentiment_global` (Mode A, Option A)
2. Mode B: `audience_fit_score = cohort_fit_score` (single bucket)
3. Per-persona: `happiness = SUS-10 score`, `task_success = completion_likelihood × 100`, `adoption = signup_likelihood × 100`, `engagement = ENGAGEMENT_BAND_TO_SCORE`, `retention_d7 = RETENTION_BAND_TO_DCURVE.d7`
4. `cohort_fit_score = 0.30·eng + 0.30·tsk + 0.25·hap + 0.10·ado + 0.05·ret` (DIMENSION_WEIGHTS_V1)
5. AARRR is **cumulative**: each stage filters the personas that passed every prior stage (v1.1 thresholds: task ≥30, retention_d7 ≥5, happiness ≥60, adoption ≥30)
6. Friction clustering: cluster n-sum + long-tail bucket = `items.length` (no silent drops)

All 6 invariants are unit-tested in `apps/api/src/__tests__/` (199 tests as of 2026-05-08).

## Tech stack

| Layer | Technology |
|---|---|
| Frontend | **Next.js 14** (App Router) · React 18 · TypeScript 5.7 · Inter Tight + Inter + JetBrains Mono · Custom OKLCH design tokens |
| Auth | **Privy** (`@privy-io/react-auth`) — identity-only (email / Google / etc → bearer token). No embedded payment wallet; a Privy Ed25519 wallet is reused only to **derive the user's Sui address** (`apps/web/lib/sui-wallet.ts`). User-side USDC transfer is opt-in / testnet (`NEXT_PUBLIC_USDC_ENABLED`) |
| Backend | **Express.js** · TypeScript · Pino structured logging · Zod request validation |
| Database | **PostgreSQL** + **Drizzle ORM** · versioned migrations (`apps/api/drizzle/`) |
| AI | **Anthropic Claude API** · Sonnet 4.6 vision (persona reactions) · Haiku 4.5 text (site classification, friction clustering, custom-question generation, audience parsing) · all calls wrapped in `withRoute(tag, ...)` for usage tracking |
| Browser capture | **Playwright** headless Chromium |
| Blockchain | **Sui testnet** · `rpm` Move package (`packages/sui-move` — `rpm::persona` / `campaign` / `mutual`, `SUI_PACKAGE_ID`) · **Walrus** sealed screenshot/persona blob storage · **Seal** encrypt-before-put · server-custodied HD Sui persona wallets (`PERSONA_MASTER_MNEMONIC`, `m/44'/784'/...`) · scans gated by the **credit ledger** (`debitScan`), no on-chain payment in the default flow |
| Infrastructure | **Railway** (Docker — API + Web + Postgres) · **Cloudflare R2** S3-compatible CDN for screenshots · Cloudflare DNS |
| Dev tools | **pnpm 10** monorepo workspaces · Vitest (199 backend tests) · Drizzle Kit migrations · tsx watch dev hot-reload · **Claude Code** as the AI-pair-programming dev tool |

## Quick Start

### Prerequisites

- **Node.js** ≥ 20
- **pnpm** ≥ 10
- **PostgreSQL** ≥ 15 (or Docker Compose, see below)
- **Anthropic API key**
- **Privy app id + secret** (free tier works)

### 1. Clone + install

```bash
git clone <repo-url> && cd 41r-persona-market
pnpm install
```

### 2. Environment

Create `.env` at repo root with at minimum:

```env
DATABASE_URL=postgresql://41rpm:41rpm_local@localhost:5433/41rpm
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-...
PRIVY_APP_ID=<your-app-id>
PRIVY_APP_SECRET=<your-app-secret>
NEXT_PUBLIC_PRIVY_APP_ID=<same-as-PRIVY_APP_ID>
PERSONA_MASTER_MNEMONIC=<bip39-12-or-24-words>  # HD-derived Sui persona wallets (m/44'/784'/...)
SUI_RPC_URL=https://fullnode.testnet.sui.io      # Sui fullnode RPC (default testnet)
SUI_NETWORK=testnet                              # testnet | mainnet | devnet | localnet
```

Optional (defaults shown):

```env
API_PORT=4100
NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:4100
USE_VISION=1                # Sonnet vision; set 0 for cheaper Haiku-text persona responses
USE_SIMULATOR=0             # 1 = skip LLM, synthesize responses for dev iteration
CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=...    # comma-separated; defaults cover localhost:3000/3001
```

Production additionally needs:

```env
R2_ACCOUNT_ID=...           # Cloudflare R2 (screenshot CDN)
R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID=...
R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=...
R2_BUCKET=41rpm-screenshots
R2_PUBLIC_URL=https://...r2.dev

# Sui chain layer (on-chain anchoring / storage / crypto)
SUI_KEYPAIR_JSON=suiprivkey1...   # operator signer (bech32; optional until publish/anchor)
SUI_PACKAGE_ID=0x...              # published rpm Move package id (after scripts/sui-publish.ts)
WALRUS_PUBLISHER_URL=...          # Walrus blob store (default testnet)
WALRUS_AGGREGATOR_URL=...
SEAL_KEY_SERVER_IDS=...           # Seal committee (threshold deferred, §6.3)
SEAL_THRESHOLD=...
```

See `CLAUDE.md` "Environment Variables" for the full list.

### 3. Local DB (Docker Compose)

```bash
docker compose up -d db     # postgres on :5433
```

Apply schema:

```bash
DATABASE_URL="postgresql://41rpm:41rpm_local@localhost:5433/41rpm" \
  pnpm --filter api db:push      # dev: push schema directly
```

For production-style deploys use `db:migrate` against `apps/api/drizzle/*.sql`.

### 4. Seed the persona pool

```bash
pnpm tsx scripts/seed-validator-cohorts.ts    # 112 personas across 8 STANDARD_COHORTS
```

Idempotent — re-running is a no-op (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING).

### 5. Run

```bash
pnpm dev                       # both api (:4100) + web (:3000) via Turborepo

# Or individually
pnpm --filter api dev
pnpm --filter web dev
```

macOS dev gotcha — if Next.js hits EMFILE:

```bash
ulimit -n 65536
WATCHPACK_POLLING=true CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true pnpm --filter web dev
```

### 6. Smoke test

```bash
# Create a Mode A scan
curl -X POST http://localhost:4100/api/scan \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"target_url":"https://linear.app","mode":"A"}'
# → {"scanId":"<uuid>","status":"pending"}

# Open the report (polls server every 800ms while in progress)
open http://localhost:3000/validator/report/<scanId>
```

A full scan takes ~3-4 minutes (capture → classify → 112 Sonnet vision calls → aggregate). LLM cost ≈ $0.11-0.15 per scan with `USE_VISION=1`.

## API surface

### Public scan endpoints (`/api/scan`)

| Method | Path | Auth | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/api/scan` | optional Privy | Create a scan (Mode A or B) and start the worker — debited against the credit ledger (Mode A $2 / Mode B $1) before the worker starts; anonymous demos capped 1/IP/day |
| `GET` | `/api/scan/:id/report` | none | Live report — polled by the UI; partial state during the worker run |
| `GET` | `/api/scan/:id/report.md` | none | Markdown export of the AI report (LLM-link-shareable) |
| `GET` | `/api/scan/:id/persona/:personaId` | none | Per-persona drill-down |
| `POST` | `/api/scan/:id/survey` | **Privy required** | Phase 5.1 — submit a human survey response (upsert keyed by user_id) |
| `POST` | `/api/scan/:id/human-aggregate` | none (operator) | Phase 5 — recompute human-side aggregate from survey_responses |
| `GET` | `/api/scan/:id/compare` | none | Phase 5 — `{ ai, human, diff }` bundle for the comparison page |
| `GET` | `/api/scan/recent` / `/top` / `/live` | none | Home-page feeds |
| `GET` | `/api/scan/me` | Privy required | The user's own scan history |

### Per-user endpoints (`/api/me`)

| Method | Path | Auth | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/me/survey-responses` | Privy required | List the user's submitted surveys |
| `GET` | `/api/me/survey-responses/:scanId` | Privy required | Detailed view — own answers + AI vs Me dimension deltas |

### Calibration + benchmark + chain

| Method | Path | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/calibration/current` | Aggregate Pearson r across all human-survey + Stagehand-baseline records (operator view) |
| `POST` | `/api/calibration/run-track-a` | (admin) trigger a Stagehand baseline run |
| `GET` | `/api/benchmark/...` | Category benchmark rollups |
| `GET` | `/api/health` / `?deep=1` | Shallow / deep health check (DB + Sui RPC pings) |
| `GET` | `/api/chain/showcase` | Provenance showcase feed for `/proof` (most-anchored scan + persona grid) |

LLM route tags (for `scripts/usage-summary.ts`): `validator.classify_site`, `validator.custom_questions`, `validator.parse_audience`, `validator.persona_response`, `validator.cluster_frictions`, `validator.cluster_human_frictions`.

## Deployment

Railway hosts API + Web + Postgres. Custom domains via Cloudflare DNS:

| Service | URL | Port (container) | Health |
|---|---|---|---|
| API | `https://api.project-rpm.xyz` | 8080 (Railway injects `PORT`) | `/api/health?deep=1` |
| Web | `https://app.project-rpm.xyz` | 8080 (Next.js standalone) | `GET /` returns 200 |
| Postgres | (internal) | 5432 | — |

Deploy commands:

```bash
# Single railway.toml at root; flip dockerfilePath before each deploy:
#   build.dockerfilePath = "apps/api/Dockerfile"  (or apps/web/Dockerfile)

railway up --service api --detach
railway up --service web --detach

# Apply pending DB migrations (production-style)
DATABASE_URL="<public-railway-postgres-url>" pnpm --filter api db:migrate
```

CORS allowlist + Railway custom-domain target port gotcha (always **8080**, not the `EXPOSE 4100` / `3000` in Dockerfiles) — see `CLAUDE.md` "Deployment" section.

## Tests

199 Vitest tests in `apps/api/src/__tests__/`. Suites cover:

- Math invariants (Option A formula, AARRR cumulative semantics, dimension weights)
- Cohort selection range-matching + L2 distance fallback
- Friction clustering n-invariant + long-tail bucket
- AARRR weighted view collapse + INTENT_ACTION multipliers
- Acquisition priors per-category arrival_share = 1.0 ± 0.01
- Site classifier prompt schema
- Persona response Q2 (site context injection) + Q3 (voice cleanup) regression locks
- Auth schema validation
- Scan shaper helpers

LLM-touching tests mock `services/anthropic_client` via `vi.mock` so the prompt path runs without real API calls.

```bash
pnpm --filter api test
```
